label: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA
note: Scenario-based synthetic dataset for reproducible offline research evaluation and demonstration.

scenarios.name: Retention
scenarios.description: User states fundamental, durable preferences that should be actively retained.

turn.text: I prefer Python for backend development.

scenarios.expected_candidate: User prefers Python for backend development.

scenarios.name: Project Context
scenarios.description: User describes long-term ongoing technical project.

turn.text: I am working on an AI agent project.

scenarios.expected_candidate: User is working on an AI agent project.

scenarios.name: Architecture Preference

turn.text: My project uses long-term LLM memory.

scenarios.expected_candidate: User's project uses long-term LLM memory.

scenarios.name: Redundancy / Merge
scenarios.description: User states semantically redundant preference that should be merged with existing memory rather than duplicated.

turn.text: Python is my preferred backend language.

scenarios.expected_candidate: Python is the user's preferred backend language.

scenarios.name: Information Update
scenarios.description: User states that they have switched tools for their current project, which supersedes prior backend language fact.

turn.text: I have started using Java for my current backend project.

scenarios.expected_candidate: User has started using Java for my current backend project.

scenarios.name: Archival
scenarios.description: User gives tentative, speculative low-confidence information that should be archived rather than kept in active pool.

turn.text: Maybe remember that I sometimes browse AI news.

scenarios.expected_candidate: Possible low-confidence memory: I sometimes browse AI news.

scenarios.name: Compression
scenarios.description: User provides verbose multi-clause explanation that should be compressed to preserve essential facts without token bloat.

turn.text: I am writing a detailed LAMM project explanation with memory extraction, scoring, redundancy detection, lifecycle decisions, SQLite persistence, vector retrieval, evaluation reports, and a Streamlit dashboard for review demonstration purposes.

scenarios.expected_candidate: User is writing a detailed LAMM project explanation...

scenarios.name: Forgetting
scenarios.description: User provides ephemeral filler information that has zero long-term utility and must be forgotten.

turn.text: This is temporary filler information that is not very useful for long term project personalization.
